name: Volumetric Path Tracing with Spectral Integration
definition: A path tracing technique that handles ray marching through participating media (homogeneous volumes) with absorption and scattering, using spectral wavelength sampling for dispersion effects like rainbow refraction.
summary: Volumetric Path Tracing with Spectral Integration renders participating media using spectral wavelength sampling for dispersion effects and spectral Multiple Importance Sampling for channel selection.
